name: crystal-accretion-adds-sheen-to-units-with-sheen
notes: Crystal Accretion: 'Put a sheen counter on each unit with a sheen counter on it' used to never run. Only the unit that already had sheen gains another.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Crystal Accretion's effect was generated as an $enterAbilities entry, but it is an Action that never enters the field, so activating it only paid its cost and sent it to the graveyard: the effect never ran. Fix: OnCardActivated() runs an Action's enter ability as its resolution effect when the card has no activation ability of its own.
